chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), that he said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) visited Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) while he had a fever, and he ordered him to eat the mountain-ash (Ghubayra).

key_terms.الغُبَيْرَاءِ: Ghubayra, a type of fruit (mountain-ash/sorbus) mentioned in hadith as a remedy for fever.
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of God (Prophet Muhammad SAWW).
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), the first Imam.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet order Ali (AS) to eat when he had a fever?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith illustrates the Prophet’s intimate care for Ali (AS) during illness, prescribing *al-Ghubayra* (often identified as mountain-ash or sorbus) as a therapeutic remedy. It underscores the practical wisdom embedded in the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking spiritual authority with holistic health practices recognized in Shia medical tradition.
